scope: The single proposed declaration in CANDIDATE.md; existing API headers are separately reproduced verbatim in SOURCE-AND-ROUTE.md.

typeParameters.name: Ω
typeParameters.extraStructure: none beyond the explicit measurable-space instance

ordinaryParameters.name: ν
ordinaryParameters.role: one fixed probability law for every k

ordinaryParameters.name: n
ordinaryParameters.scope: entire finite row after its binder

ordinaryParameters.name: ξ
ordinaryParameters.role: actual original row, not an abstract normalized-limit callback

ordinaryParameters.name: Y
ordinaryParameters.role: actual approximating row data; same upstream coding witness must later instantiate this argument

ordinaryParameters.name: ε
ordinaryParameters.role: positive small real approximation scales tending to zero; monotonicity not required

ordinaryParameters.name: D2
ordinaryParameters.role: fixed actual denominator correction, unchanged with k

ordinaryParameters.name: H
ordinaryParameters.scope: hH, hgood and probability payment conclusion
ordinaryParameters.role: measurable strict-margin good set; application-specific failure probability remains unestimated

propParameters.name: hξ2
propParameters.type: ∀ i : Fin n, MemLp (ξ i) 2 ν
propParameters.scope: all i at the same ν

propParameters.name: hξmean
propParameters.type: ∀ i : Fin n, (∫ ω, ξ i ω ∂ν) = 0
propParameters.scope: all i at the same ν

propParameters.name: hξenergy
propParameters.type: (∑ i : Fin n, ∫ ω, (ξ i ω) ^ 2 ∂ν) = 1

propParameters.name: hY
propParameters.type: ∀ (k : ℕ) (i : Fin n), Measurable (Y k i)

propParameters.name: hεsmall
propParameters.type: ∀ k : ℕ, ε k < 1 / (4 * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))
propParameters.scope: all k at the fixed n

propParameters.name: hεlim
propParameters.kind: input approximation-scale convergence, not target η/Vη/Dη convergence

propParameters.name: herr
propParameters.type: ∀ (k : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (ω : Ω), |Y k i ω - ξ i ω| ≤ ε k
propParameters.scope: all k,i,ω, pointwise rather than merely almost everywhere

propParameters.name: hgood
propParameters.type: ∀ ω : Ω, ω ∈ H → 0 < Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (ξ i ω) ^ 2) ∧ z * |D1 ω| ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (ξ i ω) ^ 2) / 8 ∧ z ^ 2 * |D2 ω| ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ)
propParameters.scope: each ω in H; no conclusion at η level is supplied

ordinaryTypedLets.name: η
ordinaryTypedLets.scope: all later lets and all conclusions

ordinaryTypedLets.name: W
ordinaryTypedLets.RHS: fun ω => ∑ i : Fin n, ξ i ω

ordinaryTypedLets.name: Wη
ordinaryTypedLets.RHS: fun k ω => ∑ i : Fin n, η k i ω

ordinaryTypedLets.name: V
ordinaryTypedLets.RHS: fun ω => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (ξ i ω) ^ 2)
ordinaryTypedLets.scope: later lets and conclusion; hgood uses the same expression expanded before this let

ordinaryTypedLets.name: Vη
ordinaryTypedLets.RHS: fun k ω => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, (η k i ω) ^ 2)

ordinaryTypedLets.name: Q
ordinaryTypedLets.RHS: fun k ω => W ω - Wη k ω + z * b ω * (Vη k ω - V ω)

ordinaryTypedLets.name: Dη
ordinaryTypedLets.RHS: fun k ω => D1 ω + Q k ω
ordinaryTypedLets.existingAPIBridge: Equals existing API RHS D1 ω + W ω - Wη k ω + z * b ω * (Vη k ω - V ω) by ring algebra; not assumed definitionally identical.

ordinaryTypedLets.name: E
ordinaryTypedLets.RHS: fun k => {ω : Ω | z * |Dη k ω| > Vη k ω / 4}
ordinaryTypedLets.scope: actual numerator event measurability, eventual and limsup payments

witnesses.canonicalEtaChoice: prescribed ordinary typed let, never a free witness
witnesses.upstreamWitnessObligation: Later original-model use must instantiate Y and ε from the SAME actual full-observation/canonical coding witness. This generic fixed-law kernel does not construct that witness.

conclusions.type: ∀ (k : ℕ) (i : Fin n), Measurable (η k i)
∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (Q k) ∧ Measurable (Dη k) ∧ MeasurableSet (E k)
∀ (i : Fin n) (ω : Ω), Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => η k i ω) Filter.atTop (nhds (ξ i ω))
∀ ω : Ω, Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => Wη k ω) Filter.atTop (nhds (W ω))
∀ ω : Ω, Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => Vη k ω) Filter.atTop (nhds (V ω))
∀ ω : Ω, Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => Q k ω) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ))
∀ ω : Ω, Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => Dη k ω) Filter.atTop (nhds (D1 ω))
∀ ω : Ω, ω ∈ H → ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in Filter.atTop, 0 < Vη k ω ∧ z * |Dη k ω| ≤ Vη k ω / 4

localQuantifiers: set inclusion expands to all ω
set inclusion expands to all ω

conclusions.type: ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ν.real (E k) ≤ ν.real Hᶜ + δ
Filter.limsup (fun k : ℕ => ν.real (E k)) Filter.atTop ≤ ν.real Hᶜ
conclusions.boundedness: Derived 0 ≤ ν.real(E k) ≤ 1, never a caller premise

routeOnlyDefinitions.name: Eorig
routeOnlyDefinitions.scope: proof-route projection of existing qualified RawNumerator API only; absent from selected theorem header

routeOnlyDefinitions.name: U
routeOnlyDefinitions.RHS: fun N => ⋃ k : ℕ, ⋃ (_ : N ≤ k), E k
routeOnlyDefinitions.scope: existing API tail sequence; proof-local use only
